sources.titre: Where do the results come from?

shamila.badge: Full text · terms checked per book

ouverts.texte: Classical Arabic texts, including rare and little-known works.

reserves.texte: Critical editions and recent translations: the reference and page are given, without copying the text.

pref.intro: Three separate settings. Changing one does not change the others.

rapport.aide: Language of explanations and summaries. Original texts always remain in their own language.
rapport.termes: Technical terms are always shown with Arabic and transliteration.
rapport.termesNonValides: Some technical terms have not yet been validated in this language. They will be shown in Arabic with transliteration.

recherche.aide: Languages used to search for sources and translations.
recherche.arabeToujours: Arabic is always included because it is the language of the original texts.
recherche.peuDeSources: Few or no sources in this language.
recherche.nonAdaptee: Search is not yet adapted to this language.
recherche.arabeSeul: Add other languages to find translations too.

pref.resume: Interface in {li} · Report in {lr} · Search in {lrd}
pref.visiteur: Your settings are kept on this device, without an account or cookies. If storage is unavailable, they remain in memory for this session.
pref.session: Storage unavailable: your settings are kept for this session.

langues.introduction: Check interface translations and documentary resources separately.
langues.avertissement: A translated interface does not mean that all sources or assessments exist in this language.

recherche.rapprochee: Query matched to the Arabic text:
recherche.exemple: Example data for this demonstration version.

selection.aide: Choose a hadith collection or a book from another category, then type a word or a number.

correspondance.similarite: Textual similarity only · to be checked

recherche.aucuneTraduction: No checked translation in your language for this text.
recherche.aucunResultatAide: The sample corpus currently holds only {nombre} hadiths. Try an Arabic word (e.g. الإيمان), a hadith number or a narrator’s name.
recherche.referenceSeulement: The text of this edition is not reproduced. Reference: [edition, volume, page].

incertain.texte: A passage from a little-known work that resembles the searched text. A resemblance or a close translation is not enough to establish that it is the same hadith.

chaine.intro: Choose the hadith, add the narrators you know, then the libraries. The report gathers every route found and each narrator’s card.
chaine.coller: Or paste a text, a number or an excerpt
chaine.etape2Aide: The search finds every route that passes through these narrators, in the order given.
chaine.faibles: Also show weak routes, with the reason for the weakness
chaine.tousLesAutres: + all the other books in the library

acces.aValider: Terms of use to be checked

rapport.nonRemplace: The original text is never replaced by a translation.
rapport.avertissement: Documentary summary: it does not replace the opinion of a qualified specialist.
rapport.cliquer: Click a narrator to see their card.
rapport.autresVoies: Other routes from this narrator: loaded from al-Maktaba al-Shāmila and the other libraries.
rapport.aucunFaible: No weak narrator in the routes shown. A weak narrator would appear in orange, with the reason in their card.

fiche.aucunJugement: No individual judgement for this link.
